words.meaning: A close and harmonious relationship in which the people or groups concerned understand each other's feelings or ideas and communicate effortlessly.
words.sentence1: From the moment they met at university, the two scholars established an effortless rapport. (From the moment they met at university, the two scholars established an effortless rapport.)
words.sentence2: Shared hardships often build a profound rapport that withstands the passage of decades. (Shared hardships often build a profound rapport that withstands the passage of decades.)

words.meaning: A state of heartfelt agreement, peaceful union, and deep mutual understanding among people.
words.sentence1: La concordia que reina en el vecindario fortalece la union de todas las familias. (The harmony that reigns in the neighborhood strengthens the union of all the families.)
words.sentence2: Despues de la sincera conversacion, renacio una calida concordia entre ambos companeros. (After the sincere conversation, a warm harmony was reborn between both companions.)

words.meaning: A harmonious understanding, agreement, and shared mutual sympathy between individuals.
words.sentence1: Une parfaite entente regne entre les deux amis d'enfance depuis de longues annees. (A perfect mutual understanding has reigned between the two childhood friends for many years.)
words.sentence2: Leur entente naturelle permet de travailler ensemble sans jamais avoir besoin d'elever la voix. (Their natural understanding allows them to work together without ever needing to raise their voices.)

words.meaning: A sense of deep familiarity, intimacy, and warm mutual connection built through time and trust.
words.sentence1: Selbst nach Jahren der Trennung war die alte Vertrautheit sofort wieder da. (Even after years of separation, the old familiarity was instantly there again.)
words.sentence2: Die ruhige Vertrautheit zwischen ihnen brauchte oft gar keine Worte. (The calm intimacy between them often needed no words at all.)

words.meaning: Deepening friendship, cordial fellowship, and mutual harmony among companions.
words.sentence1: Ryokoo o tooshite futari no aida ni fukai shinboku ga mebaemashita. (Through the journey, a deep fellowship blossomed between the two of them.)
words.sentence2: Kono gathering wa nakama-tachi no shinboku o fukameru yoi kikai to natta. (This gathering became a wonderful opportunity to deepen friendship among peers.)

words.meaning: A close bond, emotional connection, or enduring tie between people.
words.sentence1: Il loro legame speciale si e rafforzato nel corso di innumerevoli avventure. (Their special bond grew stronger over the course of countless adventures.)
words.sentence2: La distanza geografica non puo spezzare un legame fondato sulla stima reciproca. (Geographic distance cannot break a connection founded on mutual esteem.)

words.meaning: Tacit mutual understanding and seamless rapport where people understand each other without spoken words.
words.sentence1: Tamen zhijian de moqi rang ren xianmu, zhiyao yige yanshen jiuneng liaoce bǐci de xinyi. (The tacit rapport between them is enviable; just a glance is enough to guess each other's thoughts.)
words.sentence2: Duonian de youyi peiyu chu le feifan de moqi yu xinren. (Years of friendship cultivated extraordinary mutual rapport and trust.)

words.meaning: A meaningful karmic bond, fateful affinity, and deep interpersonal connection linking people together.
words.sentence1: Uyeoni kkeullyeoon mannam-i sojung-han inyeon-eulo baljeon-haessda. (A chance meeting developed into a precious, fateful connection.)
words.sentence2: Salm-eseo jo-eun saramdeul-gwa meoj-eun inyeon-eun keun chukbog-ida. (The meaningful bonds formed with good people in life are a great blessing.)

words.meaning: A strong bond, relationship, and harmonious alliance connecting people in mutual goodwill.
words.sentence1: Sompanthapheap robaong puok-ke ban kae-la-or roheut tow chea mittapheap rith-bong. (Their bond of connection improved steadily into an unbreakable friendship.)
words.sentence2: Kaa cheak-sdei ning kaa yol-chet knea thveu oy sompanthapheap nis khlang-klerng. (Honesty and mutual understanding make this connection grow even stronger.)

words.meaning: A profound feeling of emotional connectedness, mutual belonging, and enduring attachment.
words.sentence1: Daar bestaan 'n diep verbondenheid tussen die twee jarelange vriende. (There exists a deep connectedness between the two longtime friends.)
words.sentence2: Hulle gedeelde oomblikke het 'n blywende gevoel van verbondenheid geskep. (Their shared moments created a lasting sense of connection.)
